test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities, also associated with poetry and Music has been conferred with the Noble Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindra Nath Tagore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore **was born on 7 May 1861 in** Kolkata, West Bengal.**
 
• He was a poet, writer, playwright, composer, philosopher, social reformer and painter.
 
• His penname was **Bhanusingha**.
 
 
• **He became in 1913 the first non-European and the first lyricist to win the Nobel Prize in Literature. **
 
• **He won Noble Prize for his book Gitanjali.**
 
 
 
• In 1901 Tagore moved to **Santiniketan**.
 
• **Gitanjali, The Post Office, Gora, Stray Birds, Kabuliwala** are some of his very famous art works.
 
• He died on 7 August, 1941 in Jorasanko Thakurbari, Kolkata.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dwijendra Lal Ray**

 
 
• He was born on 19 July 1863, in Krishnanagar and died in 17 May, 1913, in Kolkata.
 
• He was known for his plays and songs known as Dwijendrageeti or Songs of Dwijendralal.
 
• He was civil servant, play writer, and musician.
 
 
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee**
 
 
• ​He was born on 26 June 1838, in Kolkata, and died on 8 April 1894, in Kolkata.
 
• He was an Indian poet, journalist and novelist.
 
• Anandmath (1882) is one of its most famous book.​​
 
 
 
• **Purandar Das**
 
 
• ​Born in 1484, Araga and died on 2 January 1564, Vijaynagar. His full name was Shriniwasa Nayaka.
 
• He was a Haridasa philosopher.
 
• He was a composer, singer and one of the chief founding proponents of Carnatic music.
 
 

167:T1
